list_sub_issues · create_sub_issue · add_sub_issue · reorder_sub_issues · remove_sub_issue

Link context without implying order or parenthood
list_related_issues · add_related_issue · remove_related_issue
Reports the collection GitHub returns for the requested issue; does not assume a reverse link.
Native REST links; not cached. Relationship mutations need open, in-scope targets.

Unavailable native feature? Report the refusal.
IssueMe never replaces native relationships with “blocked by”, “depends on”, or parent links in issue body text.
If child creation succeeds but attachment fails, inspect the created child and attach it—do not create another child.
